card.name: Leading digit before thousand or million
card.fires_on: The digit 1 (sometimes the 0 in 100) that starts a large round number, just before 000 or the word million. It appears in ratios, dilutions and rates.

modes.label: Dilution ratios
modes.description: The 1 after a colon or 'to' in epinephrine-style ratios such as 1:1000.

modes.label: Rates and ranges
modes.description: The 1 in a 'per 1 million' rate or in a range up to 1,000.
